CleanSpark measures its business in megawatt-hours, megawatts, and acres, with AI data centers offering a way to realize their value. Bitcoin miners can adjust electricity consumption based on prices or contracts, while AI data centers manage grid balancing differently. Sudock sees transmission, not generation, as the main US power-grid bottleneck, requiring further investment in transmission and distribution alongside solar, natural gas, and nuclear power. — link
